google-drive-sync.name: Google Drive Sync
google-drive-sync.description: Mirror Google Drive files and folders shared to the assistant's Workspace account into the content tree as text, with change/delete/un-share propagation, a budgeted download queue, and meta seeding at share roots and share points.
google-drive-sync.prerequisite: googleDrive block in jeeves-scripts.json (pipeline); sync account registered in gog (service-account mailbox); DWD grant covers gog's Drive + Sheets scopes (VCS exclusion deferred until jeeves-watcher#253: it would also de-index the mirror)
